description: Create a new contract template. Requires name, file, attributes (JSON string), email_subject, and email_body.

attributes.description: JSON-encoded object containing name, email_subject, email_body, and optionally signing_service, basic_inputs, contract_column_inputs, signers

email_body.description: Email body text when sending for signature

email_subject.description: Email subject line when sending for signature

file.description: URL or path to the contract template file

name: create_contract_template
